title: Loneliness
description: Ten minutes to be with loneliness, and to remember that in it, you are in a great deal of company.

segments.say: Find a comfortable position, and close your eyes if you like.
Feel the breath. It has been with you since your first day.
Loneliness is one of the most common pains there is. And strangely, it makes us feel we are the only one feeling it.
Notice if there is any loneliness in you right now. Where does it sit in the body?
You do not need to make it leave. Just feel it, gently.
Loneliness is not a flaw. It is a signal that you need connection, the way hunger is a signal that you need food.
Now imagine the other people who, at this very moment, also feel alone.
Someone in a hospital room. Someone in a new city. Someone in the middle of their family, unseen.
Millions of people feeling what you feel. In this, you are together.
Offer them, and yourself, these words.
May we be gentle with our loneliness.
Now feel what holds you up in this moment. The floor, the air, the light.
Think how many hands made the things around you. The clothes, the food, the house.
Even alone, you are never completely separate.
Before coming back, think of one small way to connect today. A message, a call, a good morning.
When you are ready, open your eyes.
